families.name: Anchored review conversations
families.scope: Revision-bound comments and review threads on local document objects, source ranges and preview snapshots.
families.refusal: Refuse unknown anchors, unauthorized local identities and unsupported attachment types; never infer permission from a comment.
families.recovery: Preserve original anchor revisions and thread history when objects move, disappear or are restored.
families.feedback: Expose thread scope, revision, unresolved state and inaccessible anchors with text and keyboard-reachable controls.
families.evidence: Owned multi-context fixtures verify anchor movement, private-field handling, stale replies and complete conversation export.

capabilities.title: Anchor a comment to a stable node
capabilities.outcome: An operator attaches a review comment to a stable document node and sees the same anchor after reordering that node.

capabilities.title: Anchor a comment to source lines
capabilities.outcome: A reviewer attaches a thread to a declared source range with its content revision, and the panel identifies later source drift.

capabilities.title: Anchor a comment to a viewport
capabilities.outcome: A canvas annotation records the selected viewport and state so another local session can reproduce the reviewed visual context.

capabilities.title: Reply within a review thread
capabilities.outcome: A local reviewer adds an ordered reply without rewriting earlier messages, and the thread identifies its current document revision.

capabilities.title: Resolve a review conversation
capabilities.outcome: A reviewer resolves one selected conversation with a reason, while unrelated conversations and their unresolved counts remain unchanged.

capabilities.title: Reopen a resolved conversation
capabilities.outcome: An operator reopens a resolved thread and retains its prior resolution reason, actor reference and chronological conversation history.

capabilities.title: Edit a draft review message
capabilities.outcome: A reviewer changes an unsent draft without modifying published replies, and cancellation returns to the exact prior saved thread.

capabilities.title: Attach an owned evidence artifact
capabilities.outcome: An operator links an allowlisted local evidence artifact by digest, and the thread displays its type without automatically executing it.

capabilities.title: Mention a registered local reviewer
capabilities.outcome: A composer resolves a mention against explicitly selected local identities and distinguishes an unresolved name from a registered reviewer.

capabilities.title: Filter conversations by assignment
capabilities.outcome: A reviewer filters threads by selected assignee and receives exact counts without exposing messages outside the selected review scope.

capabilities.title: Filter unresolved canvas conversations
capabilities.outcome: The panel lists unresolved threads for the current canvas document and preserves the selected thread when the list is refreshed.

capabilities.title: Navigate between annotation anchors
capabilities.outcome: Keyboard actions move between available comment anchors and announce unavailable targets without changing the inspected document or source.

capabilities.title: Detect orphaned review anchors
capabilities.outcome: A refresh identifies comments whose target no longer exists and retains their original coordinates and revision for deliberate reassignment.

capabilities.title: Reassign an orphaned anchor
capabilities.outcome: An operator previews moving one orphaned thread to a current object and confirms the new anchor while preserving its original reference.

capabilities.title: Compare a thread against its snapshot
capabilities.outcome: A reviewer opens the thread's captured snapshot alongside the current canvas and sees the exact changed anchor properties.

capabilities.title: Retain a review draft across refresh
capabilities.outcome: A locally opted-in draft is restored for the same review scope and origin without being submitted or assigned automatically.

capabilities.title: Export selected review conversations
capabilities.outcome: An operator exports selected thread records with stable anchors and chronology, with attachment payloads included only through explicit selection.

capabilities.title: Import review conversations into a rehearsal
capabilities.outcome: A local import validates identities and anchor references, previews conflicts, and leaves existing conversations unchanged when validation fails.

capabilities.title: Apply explicit thread visibility
capabilities.outcome: The panel uses declared local visibility rules when listing and opening threads, including a clear inaccessible-thread state for mismatched reviewers.

capabilities.title: Record conversation moderation decisions
capabilities.outcome: A local moderator records a bounded moderation reason and preserves the original thread record, without silently deleting unrelated review evidence.

families.name: Review requests and acceptance decisions
families.scope: Explicit review packages, revision-bound decisions and operator acceptance records for local changes.
families.refusal: Refuse stale review packages and unassigned decisions; a favorable review never grants provider or deployment authority.
families.recovery: Retain superseded decisions and pending reviewer drafts when a package is replaced or its source changes.
families.feedback: Show required reviewers, reviewed source, unmet conditions and the precise effect of accepting a package.
families.evidence: Fixtures distinguish proposal, review, operator acceptance and publication while checking exact decision provenance.

capabilities.title: Create a bounded review package
capabilities.outcome: An operator selects a change set and creates a review package containing its source revision, declared scope and required evidence links.

capabilities.title: Select required review roles
capabilities.outcome: A package owner assigns explicit review roles and sees which selected local identities can satisfy each role before requesting review.

capabilities.title: Request review without publishing
capabilities.outcome: A review request creates a local pending record and leaves source delivery, provider state and production publication unchanged.

capabilities.title: Preview a reviewer's assigned scope
capabilities.outcome: A reviewer sees the package objects and evidence assigned to that role, including explicit omissions rather than an apparently complete repository view.

capabilities.title: Record an approval for exact revisions
capabilities.outcome: An assigned reviewer approves the package's exact revision and evidence digest, and a later source change invalidates that approval's applicability.

capabilities.title: Request specific revisions
capabilities.outcome: A reviewer records actionable revision requests tied to particular package objects, and the owner can track each request independently.

capabilities.title: Withdraw a pending review request
capabilities.outcome: The owner withdraws a pending request while preserving its original package and any completed reviewer decisions for later inspection.

capabilities.title: Replace a review package deliberately
capabilities.outcome: An operator previews a replacement package and sees which earlier decisions become superseded before confirming the new review basis.

capabilities.title: Compare review package versions
capabilities.outcome: A reviewer compares two package versions and sees added, removed and changed objects with the evidence references responsible for each difference.

capabilities.title: Record an operator acceptance decision
capabilities.outcome: The operator accepts a reviewed package with explicit scope and rationale, while the record continues to distinguish acceptance from external publication.

capabilities.title: Decline a proposed acceptance
capabilities.outcome: An operator declines a package without deleting the proposal, reviewer feedback or source artifacts that established the decision context.

capabilities.title: Expire revision-bound review applicability
capabilities.outcome: The review view marks an approval inapplicable when its bound source revision changes, while preserving the original approval as historical evidence.

capabilities.title: Track conditional review findings
capabilities.outcome: A reviewer records conditions with explicit resolution criteria, and the package cannot report those conditions satisfied from a status label alone.

capabilities.title: Assign independent verification ownership
capabilities.outcome: The package records separate implementation and verification identities so the operator can inspect who produced and who examined each evidence artifact.

capabilities.title: Present unresolved acceptance conditions
capabilities.outcome: A package summary lists every unresolved required condition with its original wording and prevents a shortened display from hiding its count.

capabilities.title: Export a review decision packet
capabilities.outcome: An operator exports the exact package, decisions and evidence references with a manifest that explains excluded private attachment payloads.

capabilities.title: Reconcile imported review decisions
capabilities.outcome: An import matches decisions to exact package revisions and reports unknown reviewers or changed evidence without applying unsupported approval equivalence.

capabilities.title: Record acceptance scope exclusions
capabilities.outcome: An operator lists excluded targets and behaviors in an acceptance record so a local result cannot be presented as provider or production acceptance.

capabilities.title: Acknowledge a superseded release review
capabilities.outcome: The interface retains a superseded release review beside its replacement and explains which earlier decisions still apply to unchanged scope.

capabilities.title: Produce a review handoff checklist
capabilities.outcome: The operator generates a checklist of remaining decisions and original conditions for a named recipient without sending that checklist automatically.

families.name: Local collaboration and presence rehearsal
families.scope: Multiple explicitly owned local sessions coordinating selections, editing intent and review presence on one revision.
families.refusal: Refuse invented identity claims, expired participation records and mutations lacking the underlying command authority.
families.recovery: Expire lost sessions predictably and recover each participant draft without presenting stale presence as a live connection.
families.feedback: Label simulated identity, connection state, document revision and simultaneous editing conflicts independently.
families.evidence: Owned concurrent browser contexts verify presence expiry, reconnect, selection isolation and conflicting command refusal.

capabilities.title: Register a local participant session
capabilities.outcome: An operator creates an explicitly labeled local participant session whose display identity does not claim authenticated organizational membership.

capabilities.title: Show document-scoped presence
capabilities.outcome: The canvas lists participants attached to the selected document and distinguishes their current revision from the revision being inspected.

capabilities.title: Publish bounded selection presence
capabilities.outcome: A participant shares only selected stable object identifiers, and other sessions display those identifiers without receiving hidden document text.

capabilities.title: Distinguish viewing from editing intent
capabilities.outcome: The presence panel shows whether a participant is viewing, proposing or actively editing a supported object without granting an edit lock implicitly.

capabilities.title: Expire disconnected participant presence
capabilities.outcome: Presence disappears from the live participant list after its declared expiry while a historical session record remains distinguishable from an active connection.

capabilities.title: Rejoin a local collaboration session
capabilities.outcome: A returning participant explicitly rejoins a matching session and receives current document state without automatically replaying unsaved commands.

capabilities.title: Follow another participant's selection
capabilities.outcome: An operator opts into following a named participant's selection and can leave follow mode without changing either participant's document data.

capabilities.title: Protect private local drafts
capabilities.outcome: Draft form values remain private to their owning session while other participants receive only an explicit pending-work indicator.

capabilities.title: Announce conflicting editing intent
capabilities.outcome: Two participants selecting the same writable object receive an editing-intent warning before either proposal is accepted into the command journal.

capabilities.title: Request an editing handoff
capabilities.outcome: A participant requests control of a declared edit scope, and the current participant can acknowledge or decline without losing unsaved work.

capabilities.title: Record a completed editing handoff
capabilities.outcome: A confirmed handoff records the transferred scope and revision, while both sessions retain their own prior draft and command history.

capabilities.title: Display stale participant revisions
capabilities.outcome: The presence panel identifies participants whose selected document revision is behind the current revision and offers an explicit refresh action.

capabilities.title: Isolate participants across workspaces
capabilities.outcome: Participants in one selected workspace do not appear in another workspace's presence list, even when display names and document titles match.

capabilities.title: Bound presence update traffic
capabilities.outcome: The local collaboration service coalesces rapid selection changes and reports dropped intermediate presence updates without dropping document commands.

capabilities.title: Replay collaboration event fixtures
capabilities.outcome: A deterministic fixture replays join, selection, disconnect and reconnect events while keeping command acceptance separate from transient presence events.

capabilities.title: Pause presence sharing locally
capabilities.outcome: A participant pauses selection sharing and sees that state clearly, while ordinary local inspection and unsaved drafts continue to function.

capabilities.title: Inspect the presence event timeline
capabilities.outcome: An operator reads a bounded event timeline with participant session identifiers and source revisions, excluding draft content and credential material.

capabilities.title: Detect duplicate participant display names
capabilities.outcome: The participant list differentiates identical display names with stable session references so follow and handoff actions target the intended session.

capabilities.title: Export a collaboration rehearsal report
capabilities.outcome: An operator exports event counts, revision conflicts and session expiry outcomes from a local rehearsal without labeling fictional participants as authenticated users.

capabilities.title: Restore local collaboration preferences
capabilities.outcome: A refreshed session restores nonsecret view preferences while requiring an explicit rejoin before publishing new participant presence or selection information.

families.name: Branch and merge review workspaces
families.scope: Local document branches and explicit merge proposals after stable identities and command transactions exist.
families.refusal: Refuse ambiguous ownership, missing ancestors and unresolved conflicts; branch creation does not authorize source or provider publication.
families.recovery: Preserve branch heads, proposal drafts and conflict choices until an atomic merge or explicit cancellation completes.
families.feedback: Expose common ancestors, affected objects, conflicting revisions and the difference between preview and committed merge.
families.evidence: Deterministic branch fixtures prove three-way merge scope, conflict rejection and reversible local journal outcomes.

capabilities.title: Create a document branch at a revision
capabilities.outcome: An operator creates a named local document branch from an exact accepted revision and receives a stable reference to that starting state.

capabilities.title: List local branch ancestry
capabilities.outcome: The branch panel displays each local head and its common ancestor with the current document without inferring that equal titles imply shared ancestry.

capabilities.title: Preview a branch switch
capabilities.outcome: A branch switch preview lists pending local work and changed object counts before the operator chooses whether to continue.

capabilities.title: Switch branches with retained drafts
capabilities.outcome: The operator switches to a selected branch after resolving the draft decision, preserving drafts according to the explicitly selected retention action.

capabilities.title: Compare branch object changes
capabilities.outcome: A comparison lists objects added, removed and modified between two heads using stable identities and bounded semantic change summaries.

capabilities.title: Create a three-way merge proposal
capabilities.outcome: A proposal records base, source and destination revisions and calculates merge consequences without changing the destination document or source files.

capabilities.title: Detect competing property edits
capabilities.outcome: The merge view reports when both branches changed the same property differently and preserves both values for an explicit conflict decision.

capabilities.title: Merge independent object changes
capabilities.outcome: An accepted merge combines independent edits into one atomic document revision and retains the source branch head for later comparison.

capabilities.title: Resolve a property conflict explicitly
capabilities.outcome: An operator chooses a current, incoming or reviewed replacement value for one conflict, and the proposal records the exact selected resolution.

capabilities.title: Detect delete versus edit conflicts
capabilities.outcome: A merge proposal identifies objects deleted on one side and edited on the other, preventing silent resurrection or silent loss of the edit.

capabilities.title: Resolve ordered child conflicts
capabilities.outcome: The merge interface previews competing child order changes and applies only an explicitly reviewed order after validating parent and child references.

capabilities.title: Rebase a document branch proposal
capabilities.outcome: An operator rebases a proposal onto a newer destination revision and receives new conflict results instead of retaining obsolete applicability claims.

capabilities.title: Invalidate a stale merge confirmation
capabilities.outcome: A changed destination head invalidates an earlier merge confirmation and leaves both branch histories intact for a fresh preview.

capabilities.title: Cancel a merge preparation session
capabilities.outcome: Cancelling a merge removes only its transient preparation state and preserves both branch heads, proposal evidence and unrelated editing drafts.

capabilities.title: Undo a local document merge
capabilities.outcome: An operator previews reversing a committed merge and restores its declared destination state through the command journal without deleting the source branch.

capabilities.title: Inspect merge parent references
capabilities.outcome: The history view shows both parents of a committed merge and links each parent to the semantic comparison used during review.

capabilities.title: Name a branch review checkpoint
capabilities.outcome: An operator labels an existing branch revision as a review checkpoint without moving the branch head or changing its document content.

capabilities.title: Archive a completed document branch
capabilities.outcome: A local archive preview identifies retained checkpoints and descendants before marking a branch inactive without deleting its recoverable revisions.

capabilities.title: Restore an archived document branch
capabilities.outcome: A restored branch retains its original revision identities and history while receiving a clearly reported active status in the local branch panel.

capabilities.title: Export a branch merge rehearsal
capabilities.outcome: A report captures branch revisions, conflict decisions and resulting document digests so the same synthetic merge can be reproduced independently.

families.name: Bounded Designer command line client
families.scope: A local CLI using the same versioned query and command registry as the LAN interface.
families.refusal: Refuse unknown commands, stale revisions, shell interpolation and targets outside the explicitly selected workspace.
families.recovery: Preserve prepared proposals and command receipts after cancellation or interruption; retries must not duplicate accepted commands.
families.feedback: Provide stable exit meanings, machine-readable output and precise target and revision summaries before writes.
families.evidence: CLI fixtures use argument arrays and owned temporary repositories to verify parity with browser command semantics.

capabilities.title: Discover CLI capability versions
capabilities.outcome: A local command lists supported query and mutation capability versions with their current implementation status and declared required authority.

capabilities.title: Select a CLI workspace explicitly
capabilities.outcome: The CLI requires an explicit workspace selector when multiple workspaces are available and echoes the resolved public identity before continuing.

capabilities.title: Read a canonical document through CLI
capabilities.outcome: A read command returns the selected document's current revision and bounded structural metadata without starting providers or modifying local source files.

capabilities.title: Inspect a command schema from CLI
capabilities.outcome: An operator requests one versioned command schema and receives its required inputs, revision preconditions and possible refusal meanings.

capabilities.title: Prepare a CLI mutation proposal
capabilities.outcome: The CLI validates a proposed mutation and writes a local proposal receipt containing its declared scope without executing the mutation.

capabilities.title: Preview a CLI semantic difference
capabilities.outcome: A preview command shows the semantic and supported source consequences of a prepared proposal while preserving the workspace and command journal.

capabilities.title: Apply a revision-bound CLI command
capabilities.outcome: An explicit apply action submits a validated proposal against its exact base revision and returns a durable receipt for the accepted result.

capabilities.title: Reject stale CLI proposals
capabilities.outcome: Applying a proposal against a changed base returns a specific stale-revision exit meaning and preserves the unapplied proposal for deliberate refresh.

capabilities.title: Resume an interrupted CLI operation
capabilities.outcome: A resume command reconciles an interrupted operation using its stable request identifier and reports accepted, refused or still-unresolved outcome without duplication.

capabilities.title: Read CLI command history pages
capabilities.outcome: An operator reads a bounded page of command receipts with a stable continuation cursor and exact counts of omitted history records.

capabilities.title: Request CLI undo preview
capabilities.outcome: The CLI calculates a named command's undo consequences and lists conflicts without changing the document until a separate confirmed apply action.

capabilities.title: Request CLI redo preview
capabilities.outcome: A redo preview identifies the original command and current revision requirements so replay does not silently overwrite later accepted changes.

capabilities.title: Export CLI results as strict JSON
capabilities.outcome: Machine-readable mode emits one schema-versioned JSON result with stable error fields and excludes progress chatter from the output stream.

capabilities.title: Bound CLI result pagination
capabilities.outcome: Large query results require bounded page sizes and expose a continuation token rather than silently truncating objects or exhausting terminal memory.

capabilities.title: Cancel an owned CLI worker
capabilities.outcome: A cancellation targets only the recorded owned worker and reports whether its command reached acceptance before the cancellation request was observed.

capabilities.title: Compare CLI and browser command receipts
capabilities.outcome: A parity report compares equivalent CLI and browser commands against the same synthetic revision and identifies differences in scope, refusals or resulting digests.

capabilities.title: Validate literal CLI argument handling
capabilities.outcome: The CLI passes child-process arguments as arrays and preserves literal spaces and metacharacters without evaluating them as shell code.

capabilities.title: Read CLI output redaction policy
capabilities.outcome: An operator inspects which fields can appear in command results and sees explicit redaction markers for disallowed credential or private payload fields.

capabilities.title: Generate command-specific CLI help
capabilities.outcome: Help for one supported command presents an executable local example and explains its effects, revision requirements and possible nonzero exit meanings.

capabilities.title: Check CLI client compatibility
capabilities.outcome: A handshake reports whether the installed client can use the selected server's command versions and refuses unsupported write protocols before creating a proposal.

families.name: Capability-scoped MCP client surface
families.scope: Local MCP queries and proposals backed by the versioned Designer registry rather than unrestricted file or shell tools.
families.refusal: Refuse unsupported capability versions, unselected workspaces and mutations without their existing revision and confirmation requirements.
families.recovery: Reconcile interrupted tool requests by request identity and preserve unapplied proposals for a new explicit review.
families.feedback: Tool results distinguish query, proposal, acceptance and unavailable capabilities with bounded structured summaries.
families.evidence: Owned MCP protocol fixtures verify capability parity, stale-request refusal and absence of implicit source or provider writes.

capabilities.title: Publish a local MCP capability inventory
capabilities.outcome: The MCP server lists only implemented capabilities and their versions, distinguishing query tools from proposal, mutation and publication operations.

capabilities.title: Select the MCP workspace scope
capabilities.outcome: A tool session binds to an explicitly selected workspace and rejects later requests that attempt to substitute another workspace identifier.

capabilities.title: Read document metadata through MCP
capabilities.outcome: A query returns bounded document identities, ownership modes and current revision without exporting private content or executing an editing command.

capabilities.title: Read selected object metadata through MCP
capabilities.outcome: The client requests stable identifiers from an explicit selection context and receives an unavailable result when that selection is stale.

capabilities.title: Prepare an MCP edit proposal
capabilities.outcome: A proposal tool validates structured command inputs and returns a revision-bound local proposal without applying the proposed document or source changes.

capabilities.title: Preview an MCP command difference
capabilities.outcome: The tool exposes a prepared proposal's semantic consequences and supported source diff with exact scope and explicit unsupported-operation details.

capabilities.title: Apply an authorized MCP proposal
capabilities.outcome: An apply tool uses the existing command authority and exact proposal revision, returning an acceptance receipt rather than inferring success from tool dispatch.

capabilities.title: Reject stale MCP selection references
capabilities.outcome: A request using an old selection revision is refused without choosing a replacement object by label, position or nearest available canvas element.

capabilities.title: Bound MCP query result pages
capabilities.outcome: A query enforces declared object and payload limits and includes complete omission counts with an explicit continuation method for larger results.

capabilities.title: Expose command refusal meanings through MCP
capabilities.outcome: Tool errors preserve stable refusal codes, affected scope and repair guidance so clients can distinguish unavailable capability from invalid or stale input.

capabilities.title: Reconcile an interrupted MCP command
capabilities.outcome: A reconciliation query looks up an exact request identity and reports its accepted receipt or unresolved status without submitting a second mutation.

capabilities.title: Keep MCP source ownership visible
capabilities.outcome: Object queries include source, document or hybrid ownership so an agent cannot mistake a runtime DOM projection for a writable canonical object.

capabilities.title: Restrict MCP evidence attachments
capabilities.outcome: A tool accepts only explicitly selected local evidence references and verifies their digests without opening arbitrary files named in untrusted tool arguments.

capabilities.title: Request an MCP undo proposal
capabilities.outcome: The client prepares an undo against a named command receipt and current revision while leaving its execution subject to the normal command confirmation.

capabilities.title: Explain MCP unavailable capabilities
capabilities.outcome: The inventory reports why a planned capability is unavailable and identifies its prerequisite contract without advertising an inert panel as a working tool.

capabilities.title: Compare MCP and native UI commands
capabilities.outcome: A local parity fixture submits equivalent proposals through MCP and the UI registry and compares revision checks, scope and resulting document digests.

capabilities.title: Audit MCP request metadata locally
capabilities.outcome: An operator reads sanitized tool request metadata and acceptance references while argument payloads outside the declared evidence policy remain excluded.

capabilities.title: Handle MCP protocol version negotiation
capabilities.outcome: The client and server negotiate compatible protocol and capability versions, refusing unsupported writes while retaining supported read-only inspection where explicitly compatible.

capabilities.title: Expire local MCP session authority
capabilities.outcome: An expired local tool session loses mutation authority and receives a clear refusal while its earlier receipts remain available through authorized inspection.

capabilities.title: Export an MCP rehearsal transcript
capabilities.outcome: A local export includes tool names, revisions, results and sanitized refusal metadata, clearly identifying synthetic fixtures and excluding credential-bearing request data.

families.name: Extension manifests and bounded plugin hosting
families.scope: Explicitly installed local extensions declaring versioned capabilities, UI contributions and isolated execution requirements.
families.refusal: Refuse undeclared permissions, unsupported manifest versions and untrusted execution; installation never expands provider authority implicitly.
families.recovery: Preserve extension settings and document state when an extension crashes, is disabled or is replaced.
families.feedback: Show extension identity, requested capabilities, isolated runtime state and the effect of activation or removal.
families.evidence: Temporary extension fixtures prove manifest validation, capability isolation, crash recovery and exact uninstall scope.

capabilities.title: Inspect an extension manifest before activation
capabilities.outcome: An operator opens a versioned extension manifest and sees its declared capabilities, compatibility range and proposed UI contributions before any extension code runs.

capabilities.title: Validate extension capability declarations
capabilities.outcome: The host rejects unknown or undeclared capability requests and reports the exact manifest field responsible without partially activating the extension.

capabilities.title: Preview extension activation scope
capabilities.outcome: An activation preview lists selected workspace access, command capabilities and local runtime requirements so the operator can approve the actual proposed scope.

capabilities.title: Activate an approved local extension
capabilities.outcome: The host activates an explicitly approved extension within its declared isolation boundary and records the exact manifest version and capability selection.

capabilities.title: Register an extension panel contribution
capabilities.outcome: A validated extension contributes a named panel through a stable host contract without replacing the canvas, navigation rail or built-in inspector controls.

capabilities.title: Register an extension query contribution
capabilities.outcome: The host exposes a versioned extension query only after validating its result schema, declared scope and bounded execution requirements.

capabilities.title: Register an extension command contribution
capabilities.outcome: An extension command enters the shared proposal registry with explicit revision checks and cannot bypass the host's existing source-write confirmation requirements.

capabilities.title: Isolate extension workspace state
capabilities.outcome: Settings and transient state belong to the selected extension and workspace, preventing a similarly named extension from reading another extension's stored values.

capabilities.title: Apply extension resource budgets
capabilities.outcome: The host enforces declared time and payload limits and reports an extension budget violation without accepting an incomplete document command.

capabilities.title: Disable a failing extension safely
capabilities.outcome: An operator disables a failing extension while preserving document data, its last accepted command receipts and any unrelated active extensions.

capabilities.title: Inspect an extension crash report
capabilities.outcome: A local report identifies extension version, failed capability and sanitized failure meaning without collecting arbitrary document payloads or environment secrets.

capabilities.title: Restore extension settings deliberately
capabilities.outcome: A replacement extension previews compatible saved settings and requires explicit choices for removed or changed settings instead of silently discarding them.

capabilities.title: Preview an extension version upgrade
capabilities.outcome: The upgrade view compares capability requests, result schemas and setting migrations before replacing the currently active extension version.

capabilities.title: Rollback an extension version locally
capabilities.outcome: An operator restores a retained compatible extension version and settings while document changes remain governed by their own command and recovery history.

capabilities.title: Remove extension UI contributions
capabilities.outcome: Disabling or removing an extension removes only its registered UI contributions and returns keyboard focus to a stable built-in workspace control.

capabilities.title: Revoke selected extension capabilities
capabilities.outcome: An operator removes selected capability grants and subsequent extension requests fail clearly while previously accepted command receipts remain inspectable.

capabilities.title: Inspect extension dependency compatibility
capabilities.outcome: The host shows required extension and kernel versions and refuses activation when a declared dependency is missing or incompatible.

capabilities.title: Rehearse extension migration with fixtures
capabilities.outcome: A temporary copy runs a declared extension setting migration and compares complete before and after records without altering the operator's active workspace.

capabilities.title: Export an extension support bundle
capabilities.outcome: An operator exports selected manifest, compatibility and sanitized crash metadata with an explicit file inventory and no automatic third-party submission.

capabilities.title: Uninstall an extension with retained evidence
capabilities.outcome: An uninstall preview identifies owned files and optional settings retention, and confirmation preserves unrelated extensions, documents and accepted operation evidence.

families.name: Local workflow proposals and supervised execution
families.scope: Explicitly invoked workflows composing registered local commands with bounded inputs, revisions and observable stopping conditions.
families.refusal: Refuse arbitrary shell steps, undeclared external effects and expired source assumptions; schedules do not confer execution authority.
families.recovery: Checkpoint accepted steps and reconcile interrupted steps without blindly repeating already accepted mutations.
families.feedback: Show the next step, current source revision, pending effect and whether the workflow is planned, running, waiting or finished.
families.evidence: Synthetic workflows exercise retries, cancellation, dependency waits and compensation without provider traffic or real business operations.

capabilities.title: Define a local workflow from registered steps
capabilities.outcome: An operator composes a workflow using known command identifiers and explicit step inputs, with unsupported steps refused before the definition is saved.

capabilities.title: Validate workflow step dependencies
capabilities.outcome: The workflow validator identifies missing prerequisites and cycles and preserves the original invalid draft for correction without starting any step.

capabilities.title: Preview workflow effects before execution
capabilities.outcome: A preview expands each step's declared scope and possible side effects, distinguishing local queries from accepted mutations and unavailable provider actions.

capabilities.title: Bind a workflow to a source revision
capabilities.outcome: A prepared run records its document and source revisions so a later change cannot silently reuse the earlier workflow confirmation.

capabilities.title: Start an explicitly selected workflow run
capabilities.outcome: An operator starts one prepared local workflow and receives a stable run identity, while other stored workflows remain planned and inactive.

capabilities.title: Pause a workflow at a declared checkpoint
capabilities.outcome: The runner pauses before the next effectful step and retains the accepted-step receipts needed to understand the run's current state.

capabilities.title: Resume a checkpointed workflow deliberately
capabilities.outcome: A resume action revalidates source and prerequisites and continues only unresolved steps rather than replaying earlier accepted mutations.

capabilities.title: Cancel an owned workflow run
capabilities.outcome: Cancellation stops only the recorded owned runner and reports accepted effects separately from pending steps that never reached command acceptance.

capabilities.title: Reconcile uncertain workflow step outcomes
capabilities.outcome: A reconciliation query uses the step's request identity to determine whether it was accepted before deciding if an explicit retry is possible.

capabilities.title: Retry a refused workflow step
capabilities.outcome: An operator retries a selected retryable step after addressing its recorded refusal, preserving the original attempt and avoiding duplicate accepted commands.

capabilities.title: Supply runtime workflow inputs explicitly
capabilities.outcome: A run prompts for declared missing inputs and records their selected public identities without guessing credentials, provider targets or business authority.

capabilities.title: Branch on a validated query result
capabilities.outcome: A workflow selects a declared next branch from a schema-checked query result and reports invalid or ambiguous branch conditions without executing either path.

capabilities.title: Run bounded independent workflow queries
capabilities.outcome: The runner executes independent read-only steps within a declared concurrency budget and preserves deterministic result associations for the following steps.

capabilities.title: Wait for a local dependency condition
capabilities.outcome: A workflow waits on an explicitly named local condition with a bounded timeout and distinguishes waiting from completion or permission to act.

capabilities.title: Preview a workflow compensation sequence
capabilities.outcome: The operator sees which accepted steps have supported compensating commands and which effects require separate manual recovery before requesting compensation.

capabilities.title: Apply a reviewed local compensation sequence
capabilities.outcome: A confirmed compensation run uses normal command revisions and receipts, preserving the original workflow rather than rewriting it as never executed.

capabilities.title: Version stored workflow definitions
capabilities.outcome: Editing a stored workflow creates a new definition version, while existing run histories retain the exact earlier definition they executed.

capabilities.title: Export a workflow rehearsal package
capabilities.outcome: An export includes the selected workflow definition, synthetic inputs, expected effects and run receipts so another local environment can reproduce the rehearsal.

capabilities.title: Import a workflow definition without starting it
capabilities.outcome: A validated import creates an inactive workflow definition and reports unresolved capabilities or dependencies without scheduling or running its steps.

capabilities.title: Explain workflow publication boundaries
capabilities.outcome: The runner labels provider and production steps unavailable until their separately required adapters and operator authority are present, even after local workflow validation succeeds.

families.name: Targeted test orchestration and fixture control
families.scope: Owned local test runs selected from explicit source scopes, feature contracts and bounded resource requirements.
families.refusal: Refuse unknown executable definitions, borrowed process termination and fixtures that address nonselected projects or live providers.
families.recovery: Preserve failed-run artifacts and owned fixture checkpoints; a retry cannot overwrite an earlier failure receipt.
families.feedback: Show selected tests, omitted coverage, runtime ownership, result state and the difference between skipped and passed checks.
families.evidence: Controlled runners verify selection accuracy, fixture isolation, cancellation cleanup and honest aggregation of test outcomes.

capabilities.title: Select checks from declared source scopes
capabilities.outcome: An operator previews tests mapped to the changed source paths and sees which relevant source areas lack an explicit test mapping.

capabilities.title: Select checks for a feature contract
capabilities.outcome: A feature view lists its required checks and evidence expectations without treating a missing or planned check as an already satisfied requirement.

capabilities.title: Preview a test runner command
capabilities.outcome: The launcher displays the registered executable, literal arguments and owned fixture requirements before starting the selected test run.

capabilities.title: Create an isolated fixture workspace
capabilities.outcome: A test run creates an owned temporary workspace with blank reusable seeds and never modifies the operator's selected active project records.

capabilities.title: Allocate collision-free fixture ports
capabilities.outcome: The runner chooses free loopback fixture ports, records their owning processes and does not reuse another project's existing local listener.

capabilities.title: Apply a test concurrency budget
capabilities.outcome: Independent test groups run within a selected worker and memory budget, while conflicting fixture resources remain serialized and visibly queued.

capabilities.title: Cancel a test run with owned cleanup
capabilities.outcome: Cancellation stops only recorded owned test children, preserves available diagnostics and reports whether each fixture resource was released.

capabilities.title: Retain failed test artifacts separately
capabilities.outcome: Every failed run receives a distinct retained artifact location and cannot be overwritten or relabeled when a later retry succeeds.

capabilities.title: Rerun a selected failed test group
capabilities.outcome: A retry launches the chosen failed group against the declared current source and preserves both the prior failure and new result revisions.

capabilities.title: Compare repeated test outcomes
capabilities.outcome: The report compares outcomes across explicit repeated runs and labels intermittent behavior without converting a majority of passes into complete acceptance.

capabilities.title: Inspect fixture seed provenance
capabilities.outcome: A test report identifies the exact synthetic fixture edition and its digest so an observed result is not mistaken for production or user data.

capabilities.title: Inject a declared local storage fault
capabilities.outcome: An owned browser fixture applies a named storage failure and verifies the actual recovery controls while preserving unrelated browser workspace records.

capabilities.title: Inject a declared local API fault
capabilities.outcome: The runner configures a specific synthetic API response failure and distinguishes expected fixture errors from unexpected browser or network errors.

capabilities.title: Verify keyboard-only test journeys
capabilities.outcome: A selected journey performs declared actions through keyboard input and reports actual focus transitions and inaccessible controls with retained evidence.

capabilities.title: Capture rendered state witnesses
capabilities.outcome: A browser check records the actual visible text and accessible state that establish the result, rather than relying on source strings or hidden DOM nodes.

capabilities.title: Enforce provider-free browser requests
capabilities.outcome: A local browser suite refuses external providers and credential-bearing requests and records every attempted refusal separately from expected synthetic API traffic.

capabilities.title: Aggregate named test groups accurately
capabilities.outcome: The summary counts reported check groups from actual receipts, keeping nested reports, repeated runs and independent rehearsals from being silently double-counted.

capabilities.title: Report skipped and unavailable tests explicitly
capabilities.outcome: A test summary lists every skipped or unavailable required check with its original reason and excludes those checks from passing totals.

capabilities.title: Bind a test run to source fingerprints
capabilities.outcome: The runner captures declared source and lockfile digests before and after a run and reports drift instead of claiming an immutable observation basis.

capabilities.title: Export a test reproduction packet
capabilities.outcome: An operator exports selected fixture definitions, commands, runtime identities and sanitized reports so a recipient can repeat the failure without accessing unrelated local data.

families.name: Evidence provenance and verification records
families.scope: Addressable local evidence manifests linking exact source, environment, artifacts and review observations without inventing authority.
families.refusal: Refuse altered artifacts, ambiguous source identity and evidence containing disallowed private payloads; a digest is not operator approval.
families.recovery: Retain original receipts and qualifications when newer evidence supersedes only part of their examined scope.
families.feedback: Expose observation time, tested revision, artifact integrity, omitted scope and the precise kind of acceptance represented.
families.evidence: Manifest fixtures verify digest checks, historical preservation, bounded presentation and deliberate partial-scope supersession.

capabilities.title: Create a source-bound evidence manifest
capabilities.outcome: A result manifest records the exact examined revision and declared source fingerprints, distinguishing committed source from later working-tree metadata.

capabilities.title: Hash a selected evidence artifact
capabilities.outcome: An operator hashes an explicitly selected local artifact and receives its content digest and byte count without exposing the artifact's private contents.

capabilities.title: Verify a retained artifact digest
capabilities.outcome: A verification action compares current artifact bytes with the declared manifest digest and reports mismatch without repairing or replacing the artifact silently.

capabilities.title: Record an observation timestamp explicitly
capabilities.outcome: A receipt records observation and recording timestamps with timezone context so delayed documentation cannot be mistaken for a fresh execution.

capabilities.title: Separate source and runtime observations
capabilities.outcome: The evidence view labels source inspection, installed runtime, local behavior and provider observation independently instead of merging them into a single verified badge.

capabilities.title: Qualify a working-tree test basis
capabilities.outcome: A report identifies the source base plus exact changed-file digests when a test observed uncommitted source, without relabeling that result to a later commit.

capabilities.title: Record retained failed attempts
capabilities.outcome: An evidence index links earlier failures and their source bases beside a later pass while preserving their original failed status and diagnostics.

capabilities.title: Attach independent review observations
capabilities.outcome: A reviewer records the evidence examined and the exact conclusion scope, without turning review presence into proof that unexamined behaviors were executed.

capabilities.title: Inspect evidence scope omissions
capabilities.outcome: A manifest displays omitted files, targets and behaviors with exact counts so a shortened report cannot appear to cover an entire application.

capabilities.title: Version an evidence schema safely
capabilities.outcome: A reader validates the declared evidence schema version and reports unsupported fields or versions without silently interpreting them as a current trusted receipt.

capabilities.title: Build an artifact provenance graph
capabilities.outcome: The evidence browser shows which source, build and fixture artifacts produced a selected observation and identifies missing or unverifiable graph links.

capabilities.title: Compare evidence manifests by digest
capabilities.outcome: A comparison highlights changed source, environment and artifact digests between two observations while leaving both original manifests immutable.

capabilities.title: Apply partial-scope supersession deliberately
capabilities.outcome: An operator marks which portions of an older receipt are superseded by a newer observation while preserving still-applicable scope and original qualifications.

capabilities.title: Redact evidence exports by declared policy
capabilities.outcome: An export preview lists disallowed fields and selected redactions, and the resulting manifest identifies redaction without presenting transformed bytes as the original artifact.

capabilities.title: Detect missing evidence dependencies
capabilities.outcome: A verification report identifies absent source objects, fixtures or referenced receipts and refuses to label the incomplete provenance chain fully verified.

capabilities.title: Validate evidence path containment
capabilities.outcome: A local verifier opens only declared contained regular files and refuses symlinks or traversal that could substitute unrelated private evidence inputs.

capabilities.title: Bind an acceptance decision to evidence
capabilities.outcome: An operator decision records exact reviewed evidence digests and scope so later artifact changes cannot silently inherit the earlier acceptance applicability.

capabilities.title: Export an evidence inventory without payloads
capabilities.outcome: An operator exports bounded artifact names, types, digests and provenance links while keeping the selected evidence payload files local unless separately included.

capabilities.title: Reconcile imported evidence identities
capabilities.outcome: An import verifies schema and digest identity and distinguishes the same artifact from a similar filename or a recipient's independently generated replacement.

capabilities.title: Generate a resumable evidence handoff
capabilities.outcome: A handoff identifies the current source, retained reports, unresolved checks and next action, without claiming that the recipient has executed those checks.

families.name: Reproducible local build orchestration
families.scope: Explicit local build configurations and artifact manifests tied to source, dependency locks and selected runtime versions.
families.refusal: Refuse ambiguous working directories, missing required inputs and undeclared secret exports; a successful build is not publication.
families.recovery: Keep the previous accepted artifact intact until a complete replacement passes its declared validation and promotion step.
families.feedback: Show build inputs, selected target, pending stages, produced artifacts and the difference between warning and blocking failure.
families.evidence: Owned temporary builds compare manifests and byte digests while proving unrelated source, seeds and release snapshots remain exact.

capabilities.title: Select a named build configuration
capabilities.outcome: An operator selects a declared local configuration and sees its source entry points, output directory and target assumptions before building.

capabilities.title: Preview a build stage sequence
capabilities.outcome: The build panel expands the actual registered stage order and identifies commands that write artifacts, query registries or require external services.

capabilities.title: Bind builds to dependency lockfiles
capabilities.outcome: A build manifest records the exact package and lockfile digests so a later dependency change cannot inherit an earlier build observation.

capabilities.title: Record the selected runtime toolchain
capabilities.outcome: The runner records actual runtime and compiler versions alongside declared supported ranges, preserving a mismatch as an explicit qualification.

capabilities.title: Build in an owned output directory
capabilities.outcome: A build writes only to its declared owned output directory and leaves active source, blank seeds and unrelated project artifacts unchanged.

capabilities.title: Normalize declared build timestamps
capabilities.outcome: A reproducible build mode applies declared timestamp inputs and records remaining nondeterministic metadata instead of claiming identical bytes without comparison.

capabilities.title: Inventory generated artifact files
capabilities.outcome: The result lists generated regular files with relative paths, byte counts and digests, including explicit omissions when a configured inventory limit is reached.

capabilities.title: Compare repeated build artifact digests
capabilities.outcome: Two builds from declared equivalent inputs are compared by artifact digest, and differences identify the changed files without silently ignoring unstable output.

capabilities.title: Reject leaked LAN artifacts from builds
capabilities.outcome: The production artifact guard refuses local control-plane files and development markers before the output can be promoted as an accepted public artifact.

capabilities.title: Inspect public configuration exposure
capabilities.outcome: A build preview lists selected public client configuration keys and refuses disallowed secret-bearing values before materializing browser-facing output.

capabilities.title: Preserve the previous accepted build
capabilities.outcome: A failed replacement build leaves the previous accepted artifact addressable and distinguishes its older source revision from the failed current attempt.

capabilities.title: Promote a complete local build artifact
capabilities.outcome: An explicit promotion action accepts a fully validated artifact manifest without implying that a provider deployment or production release occurred.

capabilities.title: Rebuild an earlier accepted source revision
capabilities.outcome: An operator rebuilds a selected retained revision using declared available inputs and receives a new observation rather than a forged copy of the original receipt.

capabilities.title: Detect undeclared generated files
capabilities.outcome: The build comparison reports files created outside the declared artifact inventory and blocks promotion until their ownership and intended scope are resolved.

capabilities.title: Run a build without optional providers
capabilities.outcome: A local configuration excludes optional provider integrations and identifies unsupported provider-bound outputs without inventing credentials or activating remote services.

capabilities.title: Verify source immutability during builds
capabilities.outcome: The runner compares declared source fingerprints before and after building and refuses an immutable-source claim when build scripts changed tracked inputs.

capabilities.title: Export a build reproduction manifest
capabilities.outcome: An operator exports the build configuration, toolchain identity, lockfile digests and artifact inventory needed for another environment to attempt reproduction.

capabilities.title: Inspect dependency audit observations separately
capabilities.outcome: The build result links the actual audit observation and retrieval date while distinguishing registry findings from compiler success and runtime acceptance.

capabilities.title: Preview artifact replacement storage needs
capabilities.outcome: Before promotion, the runner estimates required artifact and retained-backup bytes and reports insufficient local storage without deleting the previous accepted output.

capabilities.title: Cancel an owned build process tree
capabilities.outcome: Cancellation targets only the build's recorded owned process tree and retains partial diagnostics without promoting incomplete output or stopping other projects.

families.name: Local Git change preparation
families.scope: Local Git inspection and reversible change preparation in the explicitly selected repository, before remote delivery.
families.refusal: Refuse repository identity drift, dirty-work collisions, protected snapshots and destructive cleanup without an exact reviewed scope.
families.recovery: Preserve unstaged, staged and untracked work; retain recoverable patch artifacts before any supported change transformation.
families.feedback: Show checkout root, branch, base revision, staged state and precise file consequences for each local Git action.
families.evidence: Owned temporary repositories test literal argument handling, dirty preservation, collision refusal and exact staged diff outcomes.

capabilities.title: Inspect the selected Git checkout identity
capabilities.outcome: The panel reports canonical checkout root, remote identity, branch and upstream so an operator can distinguish similar repositories before preparing changes.

capabilities.title: Compare local and tracked upstream revisions
capabilities.outcome: A read-only view reports exact ahead and behind counts for locally available refs and labels direct remote freshness as a separate observation.

capabilities.title: List staged and unstaged changes separately
capabilities.outcome: The change panel lists staged, unstaged and untracked paths independently and never treats ref parity as evidence that the working tree is clean.

capabilities.title: Preview a path-scoped staging action
capabilities.outcome: An operator selects exact paths and sees the resulting staged diff before a confirmed action changes the index.

capabilities.title: Stage selected reviewed source paths
capabilities.outcome: A confirmed staging action adds only the selected contained paths and leaves unrelated staged, unstaged and untracked work unchanged.

capabilities.title: Unstage selected paths without reverting files
capabilities.outcome: An operator removes selected changes from the index while preserving their current working-tree bytes and unrelated index entries.

capabilities.title: Create a local review branch
capabilities.outcome: An explicit branch action creates the chosen branch from a verified local revision, preserving current work and refusing an unexpected existing branch identity.

capabilities.title: Preview a local branch switch
capabilities.outcome: A switch preview lists paths that could collide with the target branch and refuses to hide untracked-file overwrite risks.

capabilities.title: Export a bounded working-tree patch
capabilities.outcome: An operator exports the selected tracked-file changes as a patch with exact base revision and separate inventory of excluded untracked files.

capabilities.title: Capture untracked files in a handoff archive
capabilities.outcome: An explicit handoff export includes selected untracked regular files with provenance and excludes ignored runtime or secret-bearing files by default.

capabilities.title: Validate a commit message and selected scope
capabilities.outcome: The commit preview displays the exact staged paths and proposed message and identifies unexpected staged content before any local commit is created.

capabilities.title: Commit the reviewed staged change set
capabilities.outcome: A confirmed commit records the exact reviewed index state and refuses if that state changed since preview, preserving all unstaged work.

capabilities.title: Inspect local commit ancestry
capabilities.outcome: The history view shows exact parent relationships and distinguishes a fast-forward path from a merge or unrelated local history.

capabilities.title: Preview a local fast-forward integration
capabilities.outcome: An operator previews advancing a selected local branch and receives explicit source, destination and dirty-work collision checks before integration.

capabilities.title: Integrate a verified local fast-forward
capabilities.outcome: A confirmed integration advances only the selected branch when the verified ancestry and clean required scope still match the preview.

capabilities.title: Preserve a local savepoint bundle
capabilities.outcome: A savepoint action creates a recoverable local bundle for selected committed work and verifies the expected commit and included object availability.

capabilities.title: Verify a saved Git bundle in isolation
capabilities.outcome: An owned temporary repository imports a selected bundle and compares commit identity and declared file digests without accepting untested application behavior.

capabilities.title: Detect concurrent index changes
capabilities.outcome: A staging or commit action refuses when an external process changed the reviewed index and presents a fresh diff instead of overwriting that state.

capabilities.title: Inspect Git hook execution boundaries
capabilities.outcome: The panel identifies which configured hooks may execute for a proposed local operation and keeps their existence separate from test or acceptance evidence.

capabilities.title: Generate a local Git handoff report
capabilities.outcome: A report records current refs, dirty-state inventory, retained patches and exact resume commands without pushing branches or contacting review recipients.

families.name: Owned local preview environments
families.scope: Addressable local previews with explicit process ownership, runtime configuration and source/artifact identity.
families.refusal: Refuse occupied fixed origins, unknown process ownership and borrowed service assumptions; preview availability does not establish provider equivalence.
families.recovery: Keep preview identities and prior artifact references when an owned process fails, and preserve the chosen storage origin on deliberate restart.
families.feedback: Show current endpoint, owning checkout, component readiness and whether content is live source or a retained build artifact.
families.evidence: Loopback fixtures verify endpoint probes, source identity, collision handling, independent component failures and owned cleanup.

capabilities.title: Launch a preview from selected source
capabilities.outcome: An operator starts an owned loopback preview for a verified checkout and receives its exact host, port and current source identity.

capabilities.title: Launch a retained artifact preview
capabilities.outcome: A selected build artifact starts in an owned local preview process and clearly displays its manifest identity instead of implying live source updates.

capabilities.title: Choose a fixed preview origin
capabilities.outcome: The launcher accepts an explicit loopback origin and refuses an occupied fixed port without silently moving browser-retained mock data to another origin.

capabilities.title: Select free preview ports automatically
capabilities.outcome: Automatic mode selects free loopback ports and records the actual addresses rather than reporting requested defaults that another process already owns.

capabilities.title: Inspect preview process ownership
capabilities.outcome: The status view verifies recorded process identity and working directory before offering stop or restart actions for a selected preview.

capabilities.title: Probe preview HTTP readiness
capabilities.outcome: A readiness check requests the declared application endpoint and distinguishes a usable HTTP response from a merely open listener or running process.

capabilities.title: Separate preview component readiness
capabilities.outcome: The panel reports app, LAN and each emulator readiness independently so one successful endpoint cannot hide a failed or untested component.

capabilities.title: Preview an owned session restart
capabilities.outcome: A restart preview identifies affected processes, retained origin and ephemeral runtime effects before an operator deliberately restarts the selected local session.

capabilities.title: Stop only an owned preview session
capabilities.outcome: A stop action targets the selected recorded session and refuses ambiguous ownership while preserving unrelated project listeners and processes.

capabilities.title: Recover an orphaned preview record
capabilities.outcome: A status reconciliation distinguishes an exited owned process from a live reused PID and removes only a safely identified stale runtime record.

capabilities.title: Label source preview revision drift
capabilities.outcome: The panel identifies when a live source preview differs from the revision captured by a selected review or evidence artifact.

capabilities.title: Pin a local preview to a checkpoint
capabilities.outcome: An operator selects a retained checkpoint for an isolated preview without switching or rewriting the active source checkout.

capabilities.title: Maintain browser storage origin continuity
capabilities.outcome: A restart retains the explicitly chosen scheme, host and port and explains when changing any part creates a separate browser storage origin.

capabilities.title: Inspect preview provider isolation mode
capabilities.outcome: The preview reports whether it uses native mocks, emulators or configured adapters and refuses to equate a local mode label with provider connectivity.

capabilities.title: Create a second isolated preview
capabilities.outcome: A separate preview receives independent owned ports and runtime state, while the original preview and its browser origin remain available.

capabilities.title: Compare two selected preview contexts
capabilities.outcome: The interface presents source or artifact identity for two local previews and synchronizes only explicitly chosen viewport and navigation settings.

capabilities.title: Capture a preview environment manifest
capabilities.outcome: A manifest records selected source, public runtime configuration, owned endpoints and observation time while excluding credentials and private process arguments.

capabilities.title: Expire abandoned local previews deliberately
capabilities.outcome: An operator previews stopping selected idle owned previews and sees which session records and origins remain available for later restart.

capabilities.title: Open the matching preview inspector bridge
capabilities.outcome: The launcher opens the same-origin LAN bridge associated with the selected application preview so DOM inspection does not accidentally target another checkout.

capabilities.title: Export a local preview reproduction packet
capabilities.outcome: A packet contains declared startup commands, toolchain requirements, public configuration names and source or artifact references without exporting runtime credentials or browser data.

families.name: Authorized provider publication and release delivery
families.scope: Selected provider adapters executing explicitly authorized publication from immutable reviewed artifacts and exact target identity.
families.refusal: Refuse missing provider access, stale artifacts, mismatched targets and absent operator approval; local preflight never grants production authority.
families.recovery: Reconcile uncertain provider outcomes using returned release identities and retain the previous accepted artifact and rollback scope.
families.feedback: Display account, project, environment, artifact digest, pending external effect and separately observed live acceptance.
families.evidence: Provider sandbox contracts and operator-approved target-specific drills verify exact requests, receipts and restoration boundaries.

capabilities.title: Discover selected publication adapter capabilities
capabilities.outcome: The interface lists the selected adapter's supported targets and operations, distinguishing a configured adapter from verified account access or successful publication.

capabilities.title: Verify provider target identity before publication
capabilities.outcome: A preflight reads the selected account, project and environment identities and refuses publication when they differ from the reviewed target record.

capabilities.title: Prepare a provider publication plan
capabilities.outcome: An operator prepares a plan from an immutable artifact manifest and sees the exact target, external effects and required authorization before dispatch.

capabilities.title: Record production publication authorization explicitly
capabilities.outcome: A production plan records the operator's exact approved target and artifact revision, and unrelated or later artifacts cannot reuse that approval.

capabilities.title: Run target-specific publication preflight
capabilities.outcome: The adapter validates required target configuration and artifact compatibility without publishing, and reports every unmet requirement with its original scope.

capabilities.title: Publish an approved immutable artifact
capabilities.outcome: The adapter submits only the operator-approved artifact and target, preserving the request identity and provider receipt needed to reconcile the result.

capabilities.title: Distinguish publication dispatch from acceptance
capabilities.outcome: The release view separates request dispatch, provider acceptance, completed rollout and observed live behavior rather than treating a command exit as full success.

capabilities.title: Reconcile an uncertain publication outcome
capabilities.outcome: A reconciliation action queries the exact provider operation identity and reports the known outcome before any operator-approved retry can occur.

capabilities.title: Observe the published release endpoint
capabilities.outcome: A live check verifies the selected endpoint against the expected release identity and records observation time without extending acceptance to untested routes.

capabilities.title: Publish an authorized preview environment
capabilities.outcome: An approved preview plan targets its named nonproduction environment and cannot be silently promoted to the production target through configuration fallback.

capabilities.title: Promote an existing reviewed artifact deliberately
capabilities.outcome: A promotion plan identifies the already reviewed artifact digest and the new target so the operator can authorize the distinct external publication effect.

capabilities.title: Preview a provider rollback scope
capabilities.outcome: The adapter reports whether rollback restores artifacts, rebuilds source, changes configuration or leaves data untouched before an operator approves the rollback.

capabilities.title: Execute an authorized provider rollback
capabilities.outcome: A rollback submits the selected reviewed target and release identity, then records both provider receipt and separately observed endpoint behavior.

capabilities.title: Publish an authorized source branch remotely
capabilities.outcome: A reviewed Git delivery action verifies remote and branch identity before a normal push and refuses unexpected remote advancement instead of forcing history.

capabilities.title: Create an authorized code review request
capabilities.outcome: The adapter creates a review request for the selected published branch and base, records its returned identity and avoids inferring merge approval.

capabilities.title: Reconcile remote code review state
capabilities.outcome: A readback verifies the current head, base and review state of the selected request and distinguishes those facts from completed checks or owner acceptance.

capabilities.title: Merge an explicitly authorized review request
capabilities.outcome: A merge action verifies current head, required checks and operator authorization before asking the provider to merge the exact reviewed request.

capabilities.title: Publish selected documentation pages
capabilities.outcome: An authorized documentation sync previews exact page changes, preserves provider-only pages and reads back the published content after the provider accepts the update.

capabilities.title: Inspect provider release history pages
capabilities.outcome: A bounded history view lists actual returned release identities and continuation data without inventing unavailable logs, rollback ability or complete historical coverage.

capabilities.title: Export a publication reconciliation handoff
capabilities.outcome: A handoff records exact target and operation identities, known outcomes and unresolved live checks while excluding credentials and avoiding duplicate publication on resume.

families.name: Local restoration and recovery rehearsals
families.scope: Reviewed restoration of declared local source, document, fixture and artifact scopes using retained snapshots.
families.refusal: Refuse incompatible schemas, altered backups and unowned paths; never infer that a local restore reproduces provider or production state.
families.recovery: Capture the current selected scope before replacement and reconcile partial local failures without silently pruning unrelated records.
families.feedback: Show backup provenance, selected restore scope, complete differences, storage effects and available undo before confirmation.
families.evidence: Owned failure-injection rehearsals compare complete records and source digests before restore, after restore and after supported undo.

capabilities.title: Inspect a local recovery snapshot manifest
capabilities.outcome: An operator opens a snapshot's schema, source basis, selected scope and content digests before any restore plan reads its payloads.

capabilities.title: Verify snapshot payload integrity
capabilities.outcome: The restore preparation checks every selected payload against its manifest digest and refuses altered or missing content without repairing the backup silently.

capabilities.title: Preview a document revision restore
capabilities.outcome: A plan compares the selected retained document revision with the current document and identifies affected objects before replacement is confirmed.

capabilities.title: Preview a source file restoration
capabilities.outcome: The operator sees exact contained source paths and byte differences for selected backups, with immutable release snapshots and unrelated files excluded.

capabilities.title: Preview fixture workspace restoration
capabilities.outcome: A restore plan compares complete selected fictional workspace records and preserves unselected workspace modules and their current revisions.

capabilities.title: Estimate restore and checkpoint storage
capabilities.outcome: The preview estimates replacement and automatic checkpoint bytes and refuses insufficient local capacity before changing the selected restore scope.

capabilities.title: Capture a pre-restore checkpoint
capabilities.outcome: A confirmed restore first records the current selected scope and links that checkpoint to the pending restore request for later recovery inspection.

capabilities.title: Apply a validated local restore atomically
capabilities.outcome: The restore applies only its reviewed selected scope and records a new result revision after every required payload passes validation.

capabilities.title: Reject stale restore confirmations
capabilities.outcome: A changed current revision invalidates the prepared restore confirmation and leaves the backup, current records and preexisting checkpoints unchanged.

capabilities.title: Recover from a failed local restore write
capabilities.outcome: A simulated write failure triggers supported rollback of the selected scope and reports any unresolved recovery state without claiming complete restoration.

capabilities.title: Preview undo for a selective restore
capabilities.outcome: The undo preview compares the linked pre-restore checkpoint with current selected records and shows exact directional changes before confirmation.

capabilities.title: Apply a supported restore undo
capabilities.outcome: A confirmed undo restores only the declared linked scope, creates its own result receipt and preserves unrelated changes accepted after the original restore.

capabilities.title: Retain restored snapshot provenance
capabilities.outcome: The history view links a restore result to its source backup and pre-restore checkpoint without replacing the original snapshot's observation or acceptance meaning.

capabilities.title: Restore a retained local artifact selection
capabilities.outcome: An operator selects an earlier validated artifact for local serving, while source checkout state and provider deployment remain explicitly separate.

capabilities.title: Rehearse recovery in a temporary copy
capabilities.outcome: A recovery drill materializes selected snapshots in an owned temporary workspace and verifies claimed scope without touching the active operator workspace.

capabilities.title: Inspect unsupported recovery scope
capabilities.outcome: A restore preview lists provider data, secrets and external resources absent from the backup so a successful local restore cannot imply their recovery.

capabilities.title: Handle snapshot schema migration explicitly
capabilities.outcome: An incompatible snapshot receives a migration preview with supported transformations and refusals before any converted snapshot can replace current data.

capabilities.title: Export a recovery reproduction packet
capabilities.outcome: A packet includes selected snapshot manifests, synthetic failure conditions and exact verification commands without exporting unrelated local files or runtime secrets.

capabilities.title: Label incomplete recovery outcomes honestly
capabilities.outcome: A result distinguishes restored, rolled back, partially reconciled and unresolved states, retaining the original failure information until an operator resolves it.
