capabilities.title: Resume an interrupted recovery procedure
capabilities.outcome: A resume action reads the exact restore identity and retained checkpoints, determines accepted effects and avoids repeating an already completed replacement blindly.

families.name: Portability and export contracts
families.scope: Explicit local exports describing which document, component, asset, data and runtime behaviors survive each selected target.
families.refusal: Refuse unsupported target promises, missing assets and undisclosed provider dependencies; exporting files does not prove a deployed equivalent.
families.recovery: Keep source documents and prior export artifacts intact when a selected export fails or a target contract changes.
families.feedback: Show supported, transformed, omitted and provider-bound behavior before producing a target-specific export artifact.
families.evidence: Target fixture matrices verify declared behavior, artifact manifests, reference preservation and clear unsupported-operation reporting.

capabilities.title: Inspect a target portability matrix
capabilities.outcome: An operator compares declared export targets and sees supported, transformed, omitted and provider-bound behaviors without treating all exports as equivalent applications.

capabilities.title: Preview a static site export
capabilities.outcome: A plan lists pages, assets and scripts included in a static export and identifies dynamic features that require unavailable hosted services.

capabilities.title: Export a component library contract
capabilities.outcome: An export includes selected component definitions and declared props, slots and variants while preserving the external source ownership of authored code components.

capabilities.title: Inspect exported component dependencies
capabilities.outcome: The artifact lists required runtime providers, packages and version ranges so a consumer can identify missing dependencies before importing the library.

capabilities.title: Export resolved local asset references
capabilities.outcome: A selected export materializes allowlisted assets and rewrites only supported references, reporting missing or external resources instead of silently dropping them.

capabilities.title: Preserve accessibility semantics in exports
capabilities.outcome: The target validator compares declared roles, names and relationships in exported fixtures and reports semantics that the selected target cannot preserve.

capabilities.title: Preview CMS data portability scope
capabilities.outcome: An export preview identifies selected schemas, records and references and separates portable local data from provider identifiers and unpublished remote state.

capabilities.title: Export fictional workspace records explicitly
capabilities.outcome: An operator exports selected synthetic workspace records with their complete schema and provenance, while unselected workspace data remains excluded.

capabilities.title: Validate imported portability manifests
capabilities.outcome: A consumer validates target, schema and artifact digests before opening an imported export and receives explicit incompatibility reasons without source mutation.

capabilities.title: Report form submission portability gaps
capabilities.outcome: The target report identifies forms whose validation or submission handling depends on an adapter absent from the export artifact.

capabilities.title: Report interaction portability gaps
capabilities.outcome: An export comparison distinguishes preserved local interactions from effects requiring unsupported runtime APIs, external services or unavailable interaction engines.

capabilities.title: Preserve supported locale relationships
capabilities.outcome: A target export retains declared locale tags, fallback links and direction for supported locales and reports unsupported routing or domain mappings.

capabilities.title: Preview responsive export differences
capabilities.outcome: The export view compares declared responsive modes against target capabilities and identifies transformations or omissions before producing the artifact.

capabilities.title: Separate generated and authored export files
capabilities.outcome: The manifest identifies generated files and externally authored source so subsequent exports cannot silently overwrite application code owned outside the exporter.

capabilities.title: Re-export without unrelated file changes
capabilities.outcome: An explicit re-export updates only declared generated paths and reports any destination collision with files outside the exporter-owned artifact scope.

capabilities.title: Verify a portable artifact locally
capabilities.outcome: An owned local consumer fixture opens the selected export and tests declared behaviors, preserving target limitations as part of the result.

capabilities.title: Compare export contract versions
capabilities.outcome: An operator compares two target contract versions and sees newly supported, changed or removed behavior without reinterpreting older export receipts.

capabilities.title: Inventory export environment requirements
capabilities.outcome: The artifact lists public configuration names and required runtime bindings without embedding local machine paths, credential values or provider account secrets.

capabilities.title: Export a target compatibility report
capabilities.outcome: A report includes selected behaviors, fixture results, known omissions and the exact artifact digest rather than presenting a successful archive creation as full compatibility.

capabilities.title: Rehearse portable artifact restoration
capabilities.outcome: A temporary consumer restores an exported artifact and verifies the manifest's declared scope while leaving the original source workspace unchanged.

families.name: Cross-platform runtime compatibility
families.scope: Explicit compatibility diagnostics and owned runtime rehearsals for macOS Apple Silicon, Windows x64 and Windows ARM64.
families.refusal: Refuse unsupported platform claims and ambiguous executable paths; mocked operating-system responses cannot establish native runtime acceptance.
families.recovery: Preserve platform-specific diagnostic failures and owned process evidence so later retries do not overwrite unresolved compatibility findings.
families.feedback: Display actual operating system, architecture, selected binary, tested scope and unexecuted platform requirements separately.
families.evidence: Native runs and labeled injected fixtures verify path handling, platform bindings, process ownership and portable artifact behavior.

capabilities.title: Inspect actual host platform identity
capabilities.outcome: A prerequisite report shows the actual operating system and architecture alongside supported targets without treating declared compatibility as a completed native test.

capabilities.title: Verify Apple Silicon runtime selection
capabilities.outcome: A macOS rehearsal identifies the selected Node and native package architecture and reports translated or mismatched binaries before running the supported workflow.

capabilities.title: Verify Windows x64 runtime selection
capabilities.outcome: A native Windows x64 rehearsal records executable identity and architecture, distinguishing successful runtime observation from static source or mocked process checks.

capabilities.title: Verify Windows ARM64 runtime selection
capabilities.outcome: A native ARM64 rehearsal records supported package bindings and actual process architecture so emulation is not silently reported as native execution.

capabilities.title: Handle workspace paths containing spaces
capabilities.outcome: Owned fixtures execute registered commands from paths containing spaces and compare literal argument boundaries and selected checkout identity across supported platforms.

capabilities.title: Handle Unicode workspace path names
capabilities.outcome: A platform fixture uses a contained Unicode workspace path and verifies that source reads, diagnostics and artifact references identify the intended files consistently.

capabilities.title: Validate exported namespace collisions
capabilities.outcome: A generated export or template archive validates its complete output namespace and refuses case-insensitive file or directory collisions before materialization.

capabilities.title: Validate portable line-ending behavior
capabilities.outcome: A fixture compares declared text and byte-preserved artifact policies under supported line endings without rewriting immutable snapshots or binary checksums.

capabilities.title: Validate Windows process ownership inspection
capabilities.outcome: A native probe identifies owned child processes using supported Windows process metadata and refuses termination when descendant ownership cannot be established.

capabilities.title: Validate macOS process ownership inspection
capabilities.outcome: A native probe reconciles recorded PID, command and working directory before offering stop actions, preserving unrelated local listeners and processes.

capabilities.title: Validate literal PowerShell argument transport
capabilities.outcome: A Windows launcher fixture preserves spaces, quotes and metacharacters as literal command arguments rather than expanding them through unintended shell interpretation.

capabilities.title: Validate literal POSIX argument transport
capabilities.outcome: A macOS launcher fixture preserves argument boundaries and selected environment values without treating user-supplied path or branch text as executable shell code.

capabilities.title: Inspect platform-specific package bindings
capabilities.outcome: A dependency report lists selected native bindings and expected platform compatibility, identifying unavailable packages before a build or preview launch fails.

capabilities.title: Preview platform-compatible startup commands
capabilities.outcome: The setup panel presents commands appropriate to the actual host and clearly labels commands that require an installed shell or unsupported runtime.

capabilities.title: Report filesystem capability assumptions
capabilities.outcome: A diagnostic identifies required atomic rename, regular-file, symlink and file-lock behavior and distinguishes unavailable operations from application logic failures.

capabilities.title: Verify fixed-origin startup across platforms
capabilities.outcome: Native rehearsals request the same declared loopback origin and verify actionable occupied-port refusal instead of silent fallback or unrelated listener reuse.

capabilities.title: Verify owned session shutdown per platform
capabilities.outcome: A runtime rehearsal proves the supported stop behavior on that operating system and preserves explicit guidance where descendant termination remains unsupported.

capabilities.title: Compare platform build artifact differences
capabilities.outcome: A report compares declared equivalent builds across native target systems and identifies expected or unexplained artifact differences without assuming bitwise portability.

capabilities.title: Export a native compatibility receipt
capabilities.outcome: A receipt records actual host, tools, source and executed workflows, with untested target platforms explicitly excluded from the accepted runtime scope.

capabilities.title: Separate injected platform fixtures from native proof
capabilities.outcome: The compatibility dashboard labels mocked OS fixtures and real native executions separately so unit coverage cannot satisfy a native platform acceptance requirement.

families.name: Performance measurement and budgets
families.scope: Explicit local performance measurements for declared editor tasks, workload sizes and source/runtime configurations.
families.refusal: Refuse unsupported comparison claims, hidden workload truncation and measurements lacking environment identity or complete task outcomes.
families.recovery: Retain baseline and failed-budget observations when tuning changes, and recover the prior configuration without losing recorded samples.
families.feedback: Show workload scope, limits, sample distributions, budget outcomes and task failures together instead of only favorable averages.
families.evidence: Deterministic synthetic workloads and repeated local tasks measure discovery, editing, import, rendering and recovery costs.

capabilities.title: Define an editor task performance baseline
capabilities.outcome: An operator records a named editor task, source basis, workload and measurement environment before collecting samples for later comparisons.

capabilities.title: Measure deep Navigator target discovery
capabilities.outcome: A synthetic task measures successful discovery and selection of a known deeply nested target, including wrong-target and unavailable-scope outcomes.

capabilities.title: Measure wide Navigator search behavior
capabilities.outcome: A workload measures metadata search across a declared wide hierarchy and reports scan limits, response timing and incomplete results together.

capabilities.title: Measure large document import cost
capabilities.outcome: A controlled import records elapsed time, input size and resulting object count, with validation failures and unsupported source included in the outcome.

capabilities.title: Measure semantic command acceptance latency
capabilities.outcome: A local fixture measures proposal validation and command acceptance separately so transport delay is not confused with document mutation cost.

capabilities.title: Measure inspector selection response
capabilities.outcome: A repeated task measures selecting supported objects and rendering their inspector state while verifying that the displayed target remains correct.

capabilities.title: Measure canvas viewport switching cost
capabilities.outcome: A workload records responsive viewport changes and stable rendered completion, including layout failures instead of counting every dispatched resize as success.

capabilities.title: Measure component library browsing cost
capabilities.outcome: A declared component library fixture measures filtering and opening definitions while recording result counts, virtualization scope and unavailable previews.

capabilities.title: Measure CMS binding preview cost
capabilities.outcome: A synthetic record workload measures schema-checked binding preview with declared reference depth and missing-data cases included in its report.

capabilities.title: Measure command journal replay cost
capabilities.outcome: A fixture replays a declared supported command sequence and records time, resource use and resulting digest correctness for the complete sequence.

capabilities.title: Measure undo and restore response
capabilities.outcome: A recovery workload records the time and successful scope verification for undo or restore, preserving partial failures in the measured result set.

capabilities.title: Track local editor memory samples
capabilities.outcome: An opted-in local measurement records bounded memory samples for a declared workload and environment without collecting application content or private document fields.

capabilities.title: Set explicit artifact size budgets
capabilities.outcome: A build configuration declares per-artifact and total size budgets, and the report distinguishes warnings from release-blocking thresholds selected by the operator.

capabilities.title: Set explicit editor response budgets
capabilities.outcome: A task configuration declares response thresholds and required success rates so performance acceptance cannot be inferred from an unreviewed default number.

capabilities.title: Compare equivalent workload samples
capabilities.outcome: A comparison verifies matching task definitions and reports changed environments or workload scopes before presenting performance differences between two observations.

capabilities.title: Report sample distributions and outliers
capabilities.outcome: The performance view presents sample counts, spread and retained outliers with task failures, avoiding a summary that hides slow or unsuccessful executions.

capabilities.title: Identify bounded traversal saturation
capabilities.outcome: A workload reports when node, depth or result budgets caused incomplete work so faster capped measurements cannot be presented as equivalent complete processing.

capabilities.title: Profile registered local command phases
capabilities.outcome: An opted-in trace separates validation, source reading, transformation and persistence phases for supported commands without recording disallowed input payloads.

capabilities.title: Export a reproducible benchmark packet
capabilities.outcome: A packet includes workload definition, runtime identity, samples and correctness witnesses so another owned environment can repeat the measured task.

capabilities.title: Review comparative product claims explicitly
capabilities.outcome: A comparison requires matched tasks, declared environments and complete success evidence before an operator can attach a measured advantage claim to the result.

families.name: Local operational observability
families.scope: Opt-in local diagnostics for owned services, registered operations and bounded resource observations with sanitized metadata.
families.refusal: Refuse credential or private-payload collection, unrelated process control and automatic third-party telemetry transmission.
families.recovery: Preserve failure timelines and observation gaps while recovering an owned local service or rotating bounded diagnostic files.
families.feedback: Expose component health, last observation time, known errors and missing evidence without converting an old green state into live readiness.
families.evidence: Owned service and logging fixtures verify metadata redaction, bounded retention, failure attribution and exact runtime ownership.

capabilities.title: Show component-specific local health
capabilities.outcome: The dashboard reports app, LAN and each selected emulator health independently, including the time and endpoint of the most recent actual observation.

capabilities.title: Distinguish listener and workflow readiness
capabilities.outcome: A status card labels open-port reachability, HTTP readiness and executed workflow evidence separately instead of using a single service-ready badge.

capabilities.title: Inspect owned process identity metadata
capabilities.outcome: An operator reads the selected session's PID, command identity and working directory without exposing private process arguments or unrelated application data.

capabilities.title: Display a bounded local event timeline
capabilities.outcome: The timeline shows sanitized registered operation events with ordering and source references while clearly indicating omitted records beyond the configured display limit.

capabilities.title: Correlate operation requests and receipts
capabilities.outcome: A diagnostics view links an exact request identity to its accepted, refused or unresolved result without inferring completion from a log message alone.

capabilities.title: Label stale health observations
capabilities.outcome: A card marks a health observation stale after its configured interval and distinguishes stale evidence from a newly observed service failure.

capabilities.title: Capture an owned service failure snapshot
capabilities.outcome: A failure snapshot records selected process and endpoint metadata with sanitized diagnostics, preserving the current source and runtime identity for later inspection.

capabilities.title: Inspect local endpoint probe history
capabilities.outcome: The operator reads bounded endpoint observations with actual response status and timing, including failed probes rather than only the latest successful response.

capabilities.title: Configure local diagnostic retention bounds
capabilities.outcome: An operator selects explicit file and age limits and previews affected owned diagnostic artifacts before any supported retention cleanup occurs.

capabilities.title: Preview diagnostic redaction results
capabilities.outcome: A diagnostic export preview identifies excluded credential-shaped fields and private payload categories before materializing a support report.

capabilities.title: Export selected local support diagnostics
capabilities.outcome: An operator exports explicitly selected service, source and sanitized event metadata with an inventory, without sending the report to another person or service.

capabilities.title: Report missing operational evidence explicitly
capabilities.outcome: The status view identifies unavailable probes, inaccessible process facts and unexecuted workflows so missing information cannot appear as a passing operational check.

capabilities.title: Track owned resource allocation history
capabilities.outcome: The panel records actual assigned ports and runtime identities for local sessions, preserving origin changes as explicit events rather than rewriting history.

capabilities.title: Compare declared and observed runtime configuration
capabilities.outcome: A diagnostic compares selected public configuration with actual owned endpoint observations and reports mismatches without reading or displaying secret values.

capabilities.title: Inspect sanitized command duration trends
capabilities.outcome: An opted-in local view groups registered operation durations by capability and revision while excluding command arguments outside the declared metadata policy.

capabilities.title: Identify repeated local refusal patterns
capabilities.outcome: The diagnostics panel groups stable refusal meanings and affected scopes so an operator can investigate recurring invalid or stale operations without collecting private payloads.

capabilities.title: Suspend optional diagnostics collection
capabilities.outcome: An operator pauses optional local diagnostic sampling and sees that state clearly while required command receipts and safety checks retain their separate policy.

capabilities.title: Validate diagnostic schema versions
capabilities.outcome: A reader rejects unsupported diagnostic records and preserves the original input for inspection instead of silently interpreting unknown fields as current health facts.

capabilities.title: Resume local service investigation from a handoff
capabilities.outcome: A handoff opens the retained failure context and lists which volatile probes must be repeated before the operator acts on the earlier observation.

capabilities.title: Explain provider observability boundaries
capabilities.outcome: The dashboard distinguishes local diagnostics from provider logs or production telemetry and lists unavailable external observations without claiming access or activation.

families.name: Operator learning and discoverable controls
families.scope: Task-oriented local help, guided rehearsals and discoverable controls grounded in currently implemented capabilities.
families.refusal: Refuse documentation claims for unimplemented actions and never turn a tutorial, role label or completed lesson into operational authority.
families.recovery: Retain chosen learning progress and drafts only through explicit local preferences, with safe resume and reset scope previews.
families.feedback: Provide plain effect descriptions, keyboard instructions, current capability status and actionable failure guidance near the relevant control.
families.evidence: Fixture-based task walkthroughs verify actual controls, focus, accessible names and the separation of learning completion from feature acceptance.

capabilities.title: Discover implemented controls by task
capabilities.outcome: An operator searches a task-oriented help index and receives current implemented controls with planned or unavailable capabilities clearly distinguished.

capabilities.title: Open context help for the selected object
capabilities.outcome: The inspector presents help appropriate to the selected object's ownership and supported operations without promising structural edits for an unsupported source object.

capabilities.title: Inspect keyboard shortcuts by workspace
capabilities.outcome: A shortcut reference shows the current workspace mappings and modifier differences, excluding keys intentionally disabled while typing or interacting with the preview.

capabilities.title: Rehearse Navigator discovery with synthetic content
capabilities.outcome: A guided local exercise asks the operator to find and select known synthetic objects and verifies the actual resulting selection rather than a lesson button click.

capabilities.title: Rehearse a guarded source edit safely
capabilities.outcome: A temporary-copy walkthrough demonstrates source revision checks, preview and explicit confirmation without changing the active application or reusable template seeds.

capabilities.title: Rehearse stale revision refusal
capabilities.outcome: A controlled exercise changes a synthetic source revision and shows the actual refusal and recovery controls when an older proposal is applied.

capabilities.title: Rehearse Undo with a declared local command
capabilities.outcome: A temporary exercise previews and applies a supported Undo, then verifies the original declared record scope instead of presenting an explanatory animation as proof.

capabilities.title: Rehearse selective restore scope
capabilities.outcome: An account-free exercise changes several synthetic workspace modules and verifies that a chosen selective restore preserves the unselected modules exactly.

capabilities.title: Explain source ownership at the point of action
capabilities.outcome: A control explains whether the target is source-owned, document-owned or hybrid-controlled and identifies which writes are currently supported for that target.

capabilities.title: Explain mock and provider mode differences
capabilities.outcome: A help card identifies which data and actions are fictional, emulated or provider-bound so a local exercise cannot be mistaken for real business processing.

capabilities.title: Explain the current local origin
capabilities.outcome: A session guide displays the exact current scheme, host and port and explains how browser-retained work relates to that origin.

capabilities.title: Guide owned process status inspection
capabilities.outcome: An operator walkthrough uses the actual session status controls and identifies ownership uncertainty before introducing any stop or restart action.

capabilities.title: Present action effects before confirmation
capabilities.outcome: A help surface explains the selected action's affected scope, retained data and possible refusals beside the actual confirmation controls.

capabilities.title: Return focus after help dialogs
capabilities.outcome: Closing contextual help restores focus to its actual opener or a declared fallback when that opener disappeared, without navigating the canvas accidentally.

capabilities.title: Offer accessible text alternatives for tutorials
capabilities.outcome: Every guided visual step exposes its task, target and success meaning as text so the learning flow does not depend on screenshots or color alone.

capabilities.title: Restore opted-in local learning progress
capabilities.outcome: A returning operator restores explicitly retained lesson progress for the same local profile without submitting drafts or activating previously described operations.

capabilities.title: Preview learning data reset effects
capabilities.outcome: A reset preview lists only the selected local learning records and preferences, preserving application workspaces and unrelated browser storage unless separately selected.

capabilities.title: Inspect a lesson's current capability basis
capabilities.outcome: A lesson records which implemented capability versions it describes and marks itself outdated when those versions no longer match the available controls.

capabilities.title: Export a local learning handoff
capabilities.outcome: An operator exports selected completed exercises, unresolved steps and source qualifications without including private drafts or presenting lesson completion as production acceptance.

capabilities.title: Report unsupported tutorial steps honestly
capabilities.outcome: A guided workflow stops at an unavailable required capability and explains its prerequisite, preserving progress without marking the remaining exercise complete.
